_comment: Example typhoon/tropical-cyclone track file for the Himawari processor. To use it: (1) enable 'Typhoon tracks' in the GUI/CLI/TUI (or pass --typhoon-tracks yes), and (2) either rename this file to 'himawari_typhoon_tracks.json' (auto-loaded from the project folder), point 'Typhoon Data' at this file/folder, or give an http(s) URL that returns this same JSON shape. Only storms with a fix within a few hours of the image's scan time are drawn, so keep it current. The processor also accepts a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (e.g. a GDACS tropical-cyclone feed) in the same setting.

storms.name: storm display name (required)
storms.basin: optional basin code, e.g. WP / EP / IO
storms.track: list of OBSERVED fixes (past + current), time-ordered
storms.forecast: optional list of FORECAST fixes, drawn as a dashed line

_point_fields.time: ISO-8601 UTC time (e.g. 2026-07-02T06:00:00Z); optional but recommended so the current fix tracks the scan time
_point_fields.wind_kt: optional 1-min sustained wind in knots; sets the marker colour
